title: Audit & Accounts Assistant
description:
Audit & Accounts Assistant

Bath, Somerset
£27,000 - £30,000 Full Time Permanent
37.5 Hours Per Week
ACA / ACCA Study Support Available

Join One of Bath's Largest Independent Accountancy Practices

Are you looking to develop your career within audit while gaining exposure to a varied and interesting client base? Due to continued growth and expansion, one of Bath's largest and most respected independent accountancy practices is looking to recruit an Audit & Accounts Assistant to join its thriving team.

This is a newly created position, offering an excellent opportunity for an ambitious individual who is looking to build on their existing practice experience and progress their career within a supportive, forward-thinking firm.

The successful candidate will join a collaborative team with a strong reputation for delivering high-quality audit, accountancy, tax and advisory services to a broad range of owner-managed businesses, charities and growing organisations across the South West.

The Opportunity

This role has a strong audit focus, making it ideal for someone who enjoys client interaction, analytical work and gaining hands-on experience across a variety of audit assignments.

Working alongside experienced managers and partners, you will play an important role in the delivery of audit engagements while continuing to develop your technical skills and professional knowledge.

Key Responsibilities
- Assisting with and leading sections of audit assignments for a varied client portfolio
- Planning audit fieldwork and preparing audit documentation
- Conducting audit testing and analytical review procedures
- Preparing audit files and supporting working papers
- Liaising directly with clients and maintaining strong professional relationships
- Attending client sites as part of audit assignments
- Assisting with the preparation of statutory accounts
- Preparing financial statements and supporting schedules
- Working closely with managers and senior team members on larger assignments
- Ensuring work is completed accurately and within required deadlines
- Keeping up to date with accounting and auditing standards

About You

The ideal candidate will have:
- Previous experience working within an accountancy practice (1-2 years)
- Exposure to audit assignments
- AAT, ACA/ACCA part qualification or wants to study/qualify
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities
- A proactive and positive approach to work
- A genuine desire to build a long-term career within audit and accountancy

This firm is committed to developing its people and offers full support for those wishing to study towards ACA or ACCA qualifications.

Salary & Benefits
- £27,000 - £30,000 salary
- Annual salary review
- Flexible working arrangements
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
- Your birthday off every year
- 37.5-hour full-time working week
- Personal pension scheme
- Life Assurance (4x annual salary)
- Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) and wellbeing benefits
- Cycle to Work scheme
- Full ACA/ACCA study support
- Ongoing training and professional development
- Friendly and supportive team culture
- Genuine long-term progression opportunities within a growing firm

Apply Now

If you're looking to join one of Bath's leading independent accountancy practices and take the next step in your audit career, this newly created opportunity offers the ideal combination of professional development, study support, and long-term progression.

- Your birthday off as an extra holiday

- Hybrid working (3 days office, 2 days home)

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Customer Service Advisor

Red Recruitment is recruiting a Customer Service Advisor to join our client's busy customer contact team on a temporary basis.

You will support customers across telephone, email, live chat and social media, answering a wide variety of queries relating to products, orders and installations. You will take ownership of each enquiry, working to resolve questions and complaints effectively while delivering a positive customer experience.

Package for a Customer Service Advisor:

Salary: 13.46 - 14.56 per hour, depending on experience
Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday to Saturday. Saturdays are worked on a rota, with a day off during the week
Contract: Temporary
Location: Bath, hybrid
- Varied, multichannel customer service role
- Opportunity to develop your complaint-handling and problem-solving experience
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Saturday shifts balanced with a weekday off

Key Responsibilities of a Customer Service Advisor:
- Responding to customer enquiries through telephone, email, live chat and social media
- Providing accurate information about products, orders and installations
- Taking ownership of customer enquiries through to resolution
- Handling complaints professionally and working towards first-contact resolution
- Contacting customers to arrange installations, explain the process and answer questions
- Listening carefully to customers and identifying the most appropriate solution
- Communicating complex information in a clear and accessible way
- Contributing ideas to improve processes across the team and wider business
- Sharing useful information with colleagues and updating internal knowledge systems
- Maintaining a professional, empathetic and positive approach throughout every interaction

Key Skills and Experience of a Customer Service Advisor:
- Previous B2 C customer service experience gained within a contact centre, retail or another customer-focused environment
- Experience handling complaints and taking ownership through to resolution
- Confident and professional verbal and written communication skills
- Strong listening and questioning skills
- Ability to simplify complex information and explain it clearly
- Empathetic approach and the ability to communicate with customers from a wide range of backgrounds
- Good problem-solving skills and a proactive attitude
- Working knowledge of Microsoft Office
- Positive, can-do approach with a willingness to learn and develop

If you are an experienced customer service professional who enjoys solving problems and taking ownership of customer enquiries, please apply now!

title: Part Time Accounts Administrator
description:
Are you looking for a part-time role in central Bath?

Do you have strong maths and Excel skills, with previous experience working in accounts?

Juice Recruitment is delighted to be searching for a reliable, organised and detail-oriented Part-Time Accounts Administrator to join our client in Bath.

This is a varied role combining general accounts administration with day-to-day office duties. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, updating databases and assisting with stock checks.

We are looking for someone who is confident working with numbers, with strong excel experience, and excellent attention to detail.

DAY TO DAY
- Carrying out bank and account reconciliations.
- Posting transactions and maintaining the cashbook.
- Processing and recording financial information accurately.
- Updating and maintaining company databases and records.
- Assisting with regular stock checks and investigating discrepancies.
- General accounts and administrative duties.
- Maintaining accurate filing and documentation.

WHAT WE'D LOVE TO SEE
- Previous experience in an accounts or administration role.
- Good knowledge of basic bookkeeping and reconciliations.
- Confident using Microsoft Excel and other computer systems.
- Strong Maths skills is essential.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Good organisational and time-management skills.
- Able to work independently and manage their workload.

AND FOR YOU
- 22 days + Bank Holiday's pro rata for 20 hours
- Flexible with working hours over 3 or 5 days.
- Working for a growing business.
- Excellent office environment and amentities.
- Health cash back plan.

Please apply today to be considered for this role!

title: Part time Finance Assistant - 22. 5 hours per week
description:
Are you an experienced Finance Assistant searching for a new opportunity? We are looking for a Part Time Finance Assistant to join their team on a permanent basis. This role offers a great chance to be involved in essential financial processes, supporting the wider business with purchase ledger tasks, reconciliation, and basic account management. You'll be working closely with the finance team, ensuring smooth and accurate handling of transactions, all while maintaining a welcoming and professional approach. The position is office-based in Bath, perfect for someone looking to balance work and personal commitments, with a flexible, part-time schedule.

DAY TO DAY:
- Accounts payable, processing supplier invoices, using ApprovalMax, ensuring all invoices are allocated correctly, preparing invoices for approval
- Maintain the Accounts payable ledger and payment runs
- Reconcile supplier statements and resolving discrepancies, supplier onboarding and data capture
- Accounts receivable to include checking of rents, service charges, credit control, chasing payments, providing reports to Financial Controller
- Maintaining the ledger, allocating receipts, updating tenant accounts,
- Daily bank reconciliations, posting receipts and journals as needed, credit card reconciliations, tenant deposits,
- Providing reports to the team for service charge budgets using Xero, liaising with wider team re all finance queries,
- Assisting in the preparation of month-end, assisting with preparation of year-end
- Maintain an organised digital filing system, support FC with any other duties, support wider team when required

WE WOULD LOVE TO SEE:
- Previous experience as a Finance or Accounts Assistant, ideally in property or similar sector
- Knowledge of purchase ledger processes and financial reconciliations
- Confidence using accounting software, with experience in Xero being highly desirable
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail
- Excellent communication skills and a proactive attitude
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team

AND FOR YOU:
- Benefits include competitive salary
- Flexible working hours - 5 shorter days or 3 full days
- Central Bath, modern office environment in established team

title: Payroll Manager (Part Time)
description:
Payroll Manager (Part Time)

Bath (Outskirts - Free Onsite Parking Available) Flexible Working up to 22.5 Hours Per Week Salary: £40,000 - £47,000 FTE Permanent

Are you an experienced payroll professional looking for a flexible part-time opportunity where you can make a genuine impact?

A well-established organisation on the outskirts of Bath is seeking a Payroll Manager to take ownership of payroll during an exciting period of transformation. This is a rare opportunity to lead the transition from an outsourced payroll model to a fully in-house function while supporting the implementation of a new HR and payroll system.

Working closely with HR, Finance and external consultants, you will become the organisation's payroll expert, helping to shape processes, oversee testing and ensure a successful payroll transition. Once transitioned the postholder will the be responsible for the ongoing processing of the payroll.

With a part time commitment of up to 22.5 hours per week and hybrid working available, this role could be ideal for an experienced payroll professional looking to reduce their hours, someone seeking an additional part-time opportunity, or an individual looking for a flexible position that still offers strategic responsibility and project involvement.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage the end-to-end monthly payroll process for circa 600 employees.
- Lead payroll implementation and transition projects.
- Ensure payroll compliance with HMRC and statutory requirements.
- Manage pension administration and auto-enrolment activities.
- Complete payroll reconciliations and reporting.
- Produce payroll reports, forecasts and audit information.
- Act as the key contact for payroll and pension queries.
- Drive continuous improvements to payroll processes and systems.

About You

We would love to hear from individuals who have:
- Significant end-to-end payroll experience.
- Strong payroll legislation knowledge.
- Payroll and pensions administration experience.
- Experience working with payroll and HR systems.
- Advanced Excel skills.
- A high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
- The confidence to operate as a standalone payroll specialist.

Whether you're currently a Payroll Manager, Payroll Team Leader, Payroll Supervisor, or a senior payroll professional seeking greater flexibility, this could be an excellent opportunity to utilise your expertise whilst maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

Benefits
- Salary up to £47,000 FTE.
- Hybrid working.
- Free onsite parking.
- Enhanced holiday entitlement.
- Personal pension plan.
- Health Cash Plan.
- Employee Assistance Programme.
- Flexible working opportunities.
- Cycle to Work Scheme.
- Family-friendly policies.
- Wellbeing initiatives.
- Subsidised meals and refreshments.

If you're looking for a role where you can take ownership, influence change and play a key role in an exciting payroll transformation project, we'd love to hear from you.

Please apply online ASAP. Successful applicants will be contacted within 24 working hours.

title: Project Coordinator - Full time
description:
About the Role

As a Project Coordinator, you'll manage multiple moving parts, keeping stakeholders informed, processes on track, and standards high.

Key Responsibilities
- Liaise with internal teams to ensure smooth communication and accurate documentation.
- Maintain up-to-date systems and reports for project tracking and performance monitoring.
- Deliver an excellent candidate and stakeholder experience - balancing efficiency with empathy.
- Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement and collaboration across the team.

About You
- Exceptionally organised with strong administrative and coordination skills.
- Confident communicator who enjoys supporting people through structured processes.
- Previous experience in project coordination, HR support, onboarding, or education administration is ideal.
- Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
- A proactive, team-focused approach with strong attention to detail.

What's on Offer
- Flexible working hours and supportive, people-centred culture.
- Monthly well-being sessions and regular social events.
- Stylish, modern office in central Bath with great local amenities.
